description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'MainActivity' that manages camera and video recording functionalities, including starting/stopping recording, configuring camera and MediaRecorder, and handling lifecycle events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that handles camera preview and video recording, including user interaction via a capture button.

classes.name: MediaPrepareTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask inner class that prepares the MediaRecorder asynchronously before starting recording.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds UI elements.

methods.name: onCaptureClick
methods.description: Handles the capture button click to start or stop video recording.

methods.name: setCaptureButtonText
methods.description: Updates the capture button's text label.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases MediaRecorder and camera resources when activity is paused.

methods.name: releaseMediaRecorder
methods.description: Releases and resets the MediaRecorder object.

methods.name: prepareVideoRecorder
methods.description: Configures camera and MediaRecorder for video recording, including setting preview size and output file.
